issues.description: Debug `dnf search python3.12` left in install-scripts CI step
issues.detail: The Amazon/Rocky prep steps run `dnf search python3.12` before installing. That's a debug spelunk, not a build step. It produces noise, slows CI, and if search ever non-zero-exits it kills the job. Drop the search line; just install.

issues.description: Ruff UP007/UP035/UP045 disabled wholesale with a TODO instead of actually doing the conversion
issues.detail: The PR description literally says "Use `A | B` or `A | None`" but then disables the three rules that enforce it with "TODO: Remove these - it's a lot of errors." That's the work. Land the auto-fix as a separate patch in the same series, or don't claim the move. THREE-PATCHES.

issues.description: `kw_only_dataclass` helper deleted but `default_raise` shim and stale 3.10 comments left behind
issues.detail: `default_raise` is documented as "just for < 3.10 compatibility" and the comment above `TransactionEndpointRequest` still references the < 3.10 workaround. If 3.9 is gone, either remove the shim and use real defaults, or update the comment to state the actual current reason. Dead scaffolding lies to the next maintainer.

issues.description: install.sh version-range check still allows Python 3.7-3.9 silently
issues.detail: The guard reads `PYTHON_MINOR_VER -lt 7`, but the error message now says ">= 3.10". A 3.8 interpreter passes the check and prints a contradictory message. Bump the literal to 10 so the code matches the string it prints.

issues.description: Patch mixes mechanical 3.9 removal with unrelated `itertools.pairwise` refactor
issues.detail: The `zip(ordered, ordered[1:])` -> `itertools.pairwise` change in test_priority_mutex.py is a fine cleanup but unrelated to dropping 3.9 support (pairwise is 3.10+, so it's enabled-by, but it's still a separate logical change). Split it. A diff that does two things is two diffs.

issues.description: GOOD-TASTE: collapsing the version-fork branches in cmd_classes.py is exactly the right shape
issues.detail: Removing the `if sys.version_info >= (3, 10)` forks in `option`, `chia_command`, and `command_helper` eliminates special cases that no longer need to exist. This is what dropping a version should look like everywhere. Use this as the template for the rest of the cleanup the ruff-ignore TODO is deferring.

review.summary: The mechanical 3.9 removal is correctly shaped where it actually deletes the version forks (cmd_classes.py is GOOD-TASTE). But the patch is half-done: ruff's UP007/UP035/UP045 are disabled with a TODO instead of running the auto-fix, the `default_raise` shim and < 3.10 comments are left as dead scaffolding in wallet_request_types.py, install.sh still allows 3.7-3.9 past a guard that now claims 3.10+, and a debug `dnf search` line snuck into CI. NEEDS-WORK: finish the ruff conversion (or land it as the next patch in the series), strip the stale compatibility shims, and fix the install.sh minor-version check.
